appDescription: A community app for reporting road conditions to nearby drivers.

function.name: GAZEE_CREATE_REPORT
function.description: Registers a road condition report that the driver has explicitly asked GAZEE to share.

report.description: The driver's road condition description, retaining the road name and observed condition.

function.name: GAZEE_READ_RECEIVED_REPORT
function.description: Returns the most recently received road-condition report near the driver.
